greek-compliance-aade 1.0.0 initial release:

- Adds comprehensive Greek accounting compliance features, including AADE/TAXIS integration, VAT monitoring, payroll processing, social security (EFKA/IKA), municipal tax tracking, and regulatory deadline management.
- Supports automated VAT calculations, myDATA invoice submission, and audit file (SAF-T) generation.
- Implements payroll workflows: hour tracking, overtime, salary, bonuses, severance, and all required Greek tax and social security deductions.
- Handles local tax calculations (ENFIA, municipal fees, fire department, chamber dues) and business license tracking.
- Integrates with major Greek banks for payments, SEPA processing, IBAN validation, and bank account reconciliation.
- Built for Greek accounting firms and businesses operating under Greek law.
